summary: CQC and GDC accreditation logos and a Google review link are strengths, but a booking button with no direct flow and a stale footer appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: Book Now and Book An Appointment appear to link to the contact page, so there is no direct booking flow.
findings.cost: Patients ready to book have to hunt for a form.

findings.problem: The More menu item appears to have no link, Terms and Conditions appears to point to a page ending 'copy-of-privacy-policy', and the page appears to show 'Use tab to navigate through the menu items.'
findings.cost: Dead links and leaked developer text look unfinished.
findings.fix: Working menu and correct legal pages.

findings.problem: Hours appear as '9.00AM-18.00PM' with Monday to Friday only, and the footer appears to read 2023.
findings.cost: Odd hours formatting and an old footer weaken trust.
findings.fix: Clean hours including weekends and a current footer.

findings.problem: One testimonial appears with no rating or review count, it appears to say 'extremely amicable', and the CQC link and logos appear to use http rather than https.
findings.cost: Thin proof and insecure links weaken credibility.
findings.fix: Review count with ratings and secure links.

redesign: Working menu and correct legal pages.
Clean hours, current footer and more reviews.
